newsitem.title: USA: BASKETBALL-LIBERTY LOSE, ENDING LOBO STREAK.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-LIBERTY LOSE, ENDING LOBO STREAK.

text.p: The Phoenix Mercury handed the New York Liberty their first loss of the WNBA season Monday, ending Rebecca Lobo's winning streak at 102 games.
Lobo scored eight points in the 69-50 loss by the Liberty (7-1).

"It's awful to lose," Lobo said. "Streak or no streak, it's bad to lose. We wanted to come out of here 8-0. Now it's time to start a new streak. I didn't think about that (the streak) much, the only time I did was when you (reporters) brought it up."

Lobo went 35-0 in her senior season at the University of Connecticut in 1994-95 and was a member of the U.S. national and Olympic teams that combined to go 60-0. She had not suffered a loss since March 1994 in the final game of her junior year at UConn.
Bridget Pettis scored 20 of her 25 points in the second half for Phoenix (4-2). Jennifer Gillom added 14 points and Michele Timms 11.
